body:
> Yes it's true, good point, as a solution we can also provide another option to do not use the "main index" and so the user has to specify at least one index in the options. What do you think?

I don't think it will solve the issue because even with only a different index the query will still be set on the main helper. For the suggestions example it means that the "suggested" hits and the "regular" hits will always be in sync.
